title: Use Midjourney style references in your Seedance workflow by generating visuals…
content: Use Midjourney style references in your Seedance workflow by generating visuals with --sref 2348226196 --sv 4 --v 7 to enrich and transform a concept before animating it in Seedance 2.0 Fast.
